text:
devon: quick sync — BigBank SIG requested per-question evidence delivery by EOD Fri. Need owners for Q12, Q23, Q45 (encryption-at-rest, key rotation, vendor attestations). Can we assign?

ana: I can take Q12 (encryption + KMS config). Where should I upload screenshots and the key policy?

matt: I’ll grab Q23 (rotation policy + rotation logs). I have the rotation script output and IAM audit logs. Will upload to our sales bucket.

sophia: Heads-up — BigBank requires a signed third-party attestation for Q45. @secops who owns vendor attestations / approved template?

secops: vendor attestation template is in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/docs/vendor-attest-template ; use cert-of-compliance.pdf as the wrapper. Also note: for external vendor docs we need a signed PDF + contact info. :memo:

devon: format note — follow the SIG mapping spreadsheet (column A = question id, column B = filename). Expected filenames for upload:
```
Q12_encryption_screenshots.zip
Q12_kms-policy.json
Q23_rotation_logs.tar.gz
Q23_rotation-readme.md
Q45_vendor-attestation_signed.pdf
```

matt: will upload README + logs to s3://redwood-sales/bigbank/SIG/rotation/ and post presigned links here when done.

sophia: tagging legal now. I’ll request the signed attestation from AcmeVendor and loop in @matt for any contact followup.

ana: uploaded KMS screenshots and `kms-policy.json` to s3://redwood-sales/bigbank/SIG/encryption/. Example command I used to export policy: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-id> --policy file://kms-policy.json`

sec-review-bot: reminder — SIG delivery deadline is Fri 17:00 UTC. Current missing items: Q45 signed attestation. Run `sig-validator` locally to validate mapping and required docs.

devon: owners assigned: Q12 -> ana; Q23 -> matt; Q45 -> sophia (coordinate vendor/legal). Deadline: Fri 17:00 UTC. Please confirm by EOD today so I can escalate if needed.

sophia: confirmed, reaching out to AcmeVendor legal now. I’ll post the signed PDF here once received.

matt: uploaded rotation logs and README — presigned URLs: https://s3.redwood.ai/presign/abcd1234 (rotation-logs), https://s3.redwood.ai/presign/efgh5678 (rotation-readme). :white_check_mark:

ana: confirmed upload: s3://redwood-sales/bigbank/SIG/encryption/ — added a short README with redaction notes.

devon: perfect. I’ll run the validator tomorrow morning and send the final bundle to BigBank. If anyone needs help redacting PII or stamping PDFs, ping me and I’ll help with the redaction checklist. :thumbsup:

sophia: thanks team. I’ll update here once vendor attestation arrives.

matt: ack.

ana: ack :eyes:
